== Biography ==
Janet was born before 1715. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1406|Michael Glasgow]] and [[Baird-5776|Catharine Baird]].

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1406]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Janet’s 30 January 1715 Irvine transcript names Michaell Glasgow and Katharine Baird, confirming the recurring Michael/Baird household. Literal given-name variants are compatible with the existing parents.

Recorded child and adult father, independent of Michael’s own origin hypothesis.

Next useful test: Compare original p21 and sibling entries if resolving the two FamilySearch citation variants.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3573171&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929: Janet Glasgow, 30 Jan 1715, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/3573171]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


A possible identification concerns Joannet Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Joannet Glasgow and Andrew Allexander/ on 8 August 1661 at Glasgow.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 644 / 1/230 / 230; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
